source.catalogueEvidence: Nordica 2026/27 catalogue lists Unleashed 98 flat, article 0A6694 00 001, with sidecut and radius by size for all six lengths.
source.productPageEvidence: The official product page confirms the same 2026/27 model and SKU. It gives 3160 g per pair on the selected 156 cm variant, and 4080 g per pair plus sidecut 134-98-123 mm at 186 cm in the compare table. Its interactive radii are 15.5/16/16.5/17/18/19 m.
source.radiusConflict: For the same SKU/year, the 26/27 catalogue lists 15.3/16/16.7/17.4/18.1/18.8 m. The catalogue's size-by-size values are used in the table; the official interactive-page values are retained here for audit.

limitations: Only 156 cm and 186 cm have verifiable pair weights on the product page; no weights are inferred for the other lengths.
The official product page and same-season catalogue disagree on the radii for five lengths. The catalogue's size-by-size figures are used, with the discrepancy documented above.
